jobs.title: GE Vernova Hitachi Nuclear Energy - Engineer - LOCA and Containment Analysis
jobs.description:
As a contributing member of the LOCA, Containment & Stability Analysis Team, you will perform plant thermal-hydraulic safety analysis with two-phase thermal hydraulic analysis techniques. You will support reload and design applications for Boiling Water Reactor (BWR) plants, including currently operating BWR plants as well as new plants (BWRX, Natrium) operating or planned worldwide.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Perform plant thermal hydraulic evaluations and analyses in the areas of ECCS LOCA, Containment, HELB, Fire Safe Shutdown, Annulus Pressurization Loads, and RIPD analyses.
* General expertise in two-phase thermal hydraulic analysis techniques.
* Take responsibility for fuel project activities including reload analyses, methods implementation, power uprates, new fuel introductions, and safety analysis support for emergent fuel issues.
* Perform in cross-disciplinary settings, engaged with interfacing teams responsible for mechanical design, core design, licensing, systems design, or other affiliated organizations to find optimum customer solutions.
* Prepare, document and present technical data to internal/external customers.
* Provide technical mentoring to support team development and knowledge management, including procedure development and adherence.

jobs.title: Software Architect
jobs.description:
Vill du arbeta med avancerad mjukvaruarkitektur i en tekniskt ledande organisation? Hos oss får du en nyckelroll i att utveckla framtidens serviceverktyg och mjukvaruplattformar i nära samarbete med både interna team och internationella partners. Vi söker nu en Software Architect som vill kombinera teknisk spets med helhetsperspektiv.

**Som Software Architect kommer du att arbeta med:**

* Ta fram kravbilder och design av mjukvaruarkitekturer på system-, nod- och modulnivå
* Driva tekniska vägval, komponentval och bidra till roadmap för plattformar
* Stötta utvecklingsteam genom vägledning, utbildning och tekniskt ledarskap
* Delta i test, verifiering och releaseplanering av mjukvarulösningar
* Utföra avancerad felsökning samt ha dialog med intressenter

Som Software Architect inom vår mjukvarugrupp med fokus på serviceverktyg har du en central roll i att utveckla, vidareutveckla och säkra kvaliteten på våra mjukvarulösningar och plattformar. Du arbetar genom hela utvecklingskedjan, från att skriva/analysera krav och omsätta dem till hållbara arkitekturlösningar, till att säkerställa implementation, verifiering och vidareutveckling.

Rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med utvecklare, designers och systemingenjörer, där du fungerar som en teknisk ledare och kunskapsbärare. Du bidrar till att skapa struktur och riktning i utvecklingsarbetet genom att definiera arkitekturprinciper, etablera standarder och driva kontinuerliga förbättringar.

Du har även en viktig roll i kontakten med andra delar av organisationen, såsom produktion, marknad, samt med övriga R&D. Genom denna samverkan säkerställer du att lösningarna möter både tekniska krav och verksamhetens behov.

Tjänsten passar dig som trivs med att arbeta både strategiskt och operativt, har en stark analytisk förmåga och vill ta ett stort ansvar i att forma framtidens mjukvarulösningar. Här får du möjlighet att påverka teknikval, driva innovation och bidra till att skapa effektiva och robusta system med höga krav på kvalitet, säkerhet och funktionalitet.

**Till tjänsten som Software Architect söker vi dig som har/är:**

* Civilingenjörsutbildning inom mjukvara eller motsvarande
* Minst 5 års erfarenhet av fullstack med Windows-applikationer i C#, .NET och typescript/React
* God kunskap i engelska tal och skrift, meriterande om du även har goda svenskkunskaper

För att lyckas i rollen har du god kommunikativ förmåga, både skriftligt och verbalt och trivs med att samarbeta med andra för att nå gemensamma mål. Samtidigt arbetar du självständigt och har förmågan att driva aktiviteter framåt hela vägen till måluppfyllelse.

**Vilka är R&D Toyota Material Handling Europe?**
  
Toyota Material Handling Europe är världsledande inom materialhantering och vi gör stora investeringar för att möta framtidens behov. På vår R&D-avdelning i Mjölby arbetar 300 medarbetare med utveckling av våra produkter och tjänster samt nya innovativa lösningar. På Toyota arbetar vi med ett helhetsperspektiv där medarbetarna har ansvar från koncept till färdig produkt.
  
På Toyota förenar vi klassisk konstruktion med modern teknik inom automation, IoT och AI. Vårt produktutbud sträcker sig från manuella handtruckar till förarlösa fordon med avancerad teknik. På R&D avdelningen arbetar vi med korta utvecklingscykler för att möta efterfrågan på en snabbt växande marknad.

Medarbetarna inom R&D beskriver våra chefer och ledare som inkluderande, närvarande och prestigelösa. Vi på Toyota är måna om att skapa ett familjärt arbetsklimat med möjlighet till personlig utveckling och goda karriärmöjligheter.

**Din Framtid på Toyota Material Handling Europe**
  
På Toyota Material Handling Europe strävar vi efter att vara en vänskaplig, trygg och framåtsträvande arbetsplats. Vår kultur bygger på Toyotas värdegrund, där respekt och omsorg är centrala i det dagliga arbetet. Vi arbetar aktivt för att öka mångfalden och ta vara på olikheter, vilket stärker vår konkurrenskraft.
  
För att skapa förutsättningar till en hållbar vardag erbjuder vi våra medarbetare flextid och möjlighet till distansarbete på deltid.

Låter det intressant? Ansök i så fall senast 2026-10-25.

Du som söker jobb och har skyddad identitet ska kontakta HR, som kommer guida dig vidare för en säker ansökningsprocess.

jobs.title: Security Engineer, Core
jobs.description:
THE OPPORTUNITY IN A NUTSHELL You? Empathetic with the people you work with, proactive about the work itself, and creative about how you solve it. Your passion is squashing bug classes at scale and helping developers without blocking them Role? As a Security Engineer, you will own application security work end to end: bug bounty triage, code scanning, vulnerability management, and incidents.
  
  
AI agents are a big part of how we scale that work. You will use them every day and help build new ones. Tech stack? Our marketplaces run on Java/Kotlin, JavaScript/TypeScript, C# and Go, and some teams even use Haskell.
  
  
We run on AWS and GCP, and most apps deploy to Kubernetes. We build our agents with whichever models fit the job best Location? Join us in our Stockholm, Oslo, or Aarhus office with the flexibility to work 3 days per week remotely. Company?
  
  
Vend, home of FINN, Blocket, Tori, Oikotie, DBA and Bilbasen. Around 500 developers deploy code to production several thousand times a week. Why us? Most security teams are still deciding what to do with LLMs.
  
  
We have spent a year running agents on production security work and measuring what actually helps. You will join while we are still working out the methods, and help shape them. Sounds like your cup of tea? Check out the details below!
  
  
**WHO ARE YOU? Security Experience:** You have found and fixed vulnerabilities in real applications. You are comfortable in code you did not write, and can tell an impactful finding from noise. Engineering Background: You have shipped code to production.
  
  
You would rather build the thing that prevents a bug class, or the agent that finds it, than write the report about it. Hands-on with AI: You already use LLMs in your daily work and want to push them further, by giving agents tools, context and harder problems. Experience building agents is a plus, but not required. Fast Learner: You pick up new, complex topics quickly.
  
  
In this field, what worked six months ago might not be the best approach today. English Fluency: You write and speak English well. It is the working language across our teams in Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Poland, and Finland. Education: A degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  
  
We value different paths into security. WHAT'S THE JOB LIKE? Day-to-day work We used to automate with code. Now we automate with reasoning.
  
  
Security scanners find patterns, but confirming a real risk takes investigation: tracing a request across services, finding who owns them, checking how they are exposed, reading logs, and testing whether an attack works. We are teaching agents to do more of that investigation, so you can spend your time on the findings that matter. The Product Security Team We are seven people spread across the Nordics, and we meet up regularly to work together. We are part of the Delivery Platforms area in Vend.
  
  
Core Delivery Platforms helps Vend create real value by turning delivery into a trusted, measurable flow. We build composable, self-serve platform capabilities and provide services that reduce friction and power the flow that connects build, data, and AI, so ideas become outcomes faster.If you want to learn more about Emil and the team, you can follow this Link here: vend.com/news/inside-vends-product-security-team-a-year-of-ai-agents-on-our-production-systems GOT YOUR ATTENTION? Let us hear from you! Make sure to apply by 25 October 2026.
  
  
Please attach a CV and help us answer the pre-screening questions QUESTIONS? Emil Vaagland, Head of Product Security, is happy to provide information about the daily work and answer any questions you may have about the role, you can reach out via email: emil.vaagland@vend.com. For the recruitment process and other topics, you can reach out to Clayton Don Corda, Senior TA Partner, via clayton.don.corda@vend.com At Vend, our mission is simple: Smart choices made easy. We’re here to make sustainable living effortless through seamless digital experiences.
  
  
As part of a dynamic family of marketplaces, including FINN, Blocket, Tori, Bytbil, Oikotie, Bilbasen, and DBA, we connect people with services and products that matter. Driven by purpose and curiosity, we constantly evolve to meet today’s needs and shape a smarter, more sustainable tomorrow. At Vend, your time matters. We want you to explore new paths to smarter.
  
  
Be curious with technology and lean forward. Dare to try, learn, and try again, as we innovate, grow and succeed together. Because your time matters. And when spent wisely, it creates value for you, for Vend, and society as a whole.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Developer - TRATON Workshop Suite
jobs.description:
TRATON is a group of strong brands with a shared mission: transforming transportation together to create the future of sustainable transport solutions. Within TRATON, we include MAN, Scania, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International. As part of a global team of industry experts, you get to think bigger, experience more, and reach further. Together, we have the power to transform transportation - Let´s make a difference together. Find out more: www.traton.com

Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do.

**Role Summary**
----------------

*This role is part of TRATON Group R&D, located in Södertälje, Sweden.*

  

As a **Full-Stack Software Developer**, you will join Team Jaguar, one of several cross-functional development teams working together to build the **TRATON Workshop Suite (TWS)** – the digital workshop platform supporting technicians in servicing, maintaining and updating vehicles across the TRATON Group.

  

Team Jaguar is responsible for the **Software Update domain**, developing user-facing functionality that enables workshop technicians to safely and efficiently update vehicle software. The team owns the functionality and user experience end-to-end, from the workshop application through backend and cloud services. To deliver the complete solution, we collaborate closely with other TWS teams and use shared capabilities such as product and vehicle communication services.

  

In this role, you will work across the full technology stack, primarily using **C#/.NET, AWS and Angular** in a microservice-based architecture. The solutions you develop are ultimately used by workshop technicians in their daily work, giving the role a clear connection between the technology we build and the value it creates for our users.

  

You will be part of a team with shared responsibility for building, operating and continuously improving stable, secure and user-friendly solutions that support efficient workshop operations across the TRATON Group.

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Develop and maintain **full-stack functionality within the Software Update domain**, using C#/.NET, AWS and Angular across frontend, backend, microservices and APIs;
* Build robust and user-friendly solutions that enable **safe and reliable software updates of vehicles**;
* Take part in the complete software lifecycle – from requirements, design and implementation to testing, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, support and maintenance;
* Collaborate closely with developers, testers, Product Owner and Scrum Master within the team, as well as with other teams across TWS;
* Troubleshoot complex technical issues across frontend, backend, cloud services and integrations;
* Continuously improve system stability, observability, maintainability, quality and user experience;
* Contribute to testing and validation in development environments, rigs and real vehicles;
* Contribute actively to the team's way of working, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

**Who You Are**
---------------

We believe you are a collaborative and curious full-stack software developer who enjoys solving real problems for end users and understanding the complete solution.

  

You have **at least 3 years of relevant professional experience** and a solid foundation in software development. You don't need to have worked with every technology in our stack – what matters is that you have relevant experience, enjoy learning and can contribute effectively as part of a team.

  

You have experience with **C#/.NET, cloud development such as AWS and microservice architectures**, combined with frontend development. **Experience with Angular is preferred**, while experience with other modern frontend frameworks, such as React, is also valuable.

  

You do not need to be equally strong in frontend and backend development, but you should be comfortable working across both and willing to contribute wherever the team needs you.

  

For us, technical competence is only part of what makes a great developer. **How you collaborate, communicate and contribute to the team is equally important.** We are looking for someone who enjoys working closely with others, shares knowledge, asks for help when needed and actively helps others succeed. We value shared ownership and believe that the best results are achieved together.

  

You are comfortable communicating with different audiences – from discussing technical details with fellow developers to explaining complex technical topics to stakeholders with different levels of technical knowledge. You can adapt your communication to your audience, making complex topics understandable without losing what is important. You listen to different perspectives and seek to understand the needs behind what we build.

  

You take initiative and ownership while staying aligned with the team. You are curious about the customer and want to understand not only **how** something should be built, but **why it matters to the people using it**.

  

Experience within automotive software, vehicle communication, distributed systems, DevOps, observability or similar technically complex environments is considered an advantage, but not a requirement. Most importantly, you are motivated to learn the domain, contribute to the team and grow together with us.

  

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and value different experiences and perspectives. **If you are excited about the role but don't meet every qualification listed, we still encourage you to apply.**

**This Is Us**
--------------

**Team Jaguar** is a cross-functional team of developers and testers responsible for the **Software Update domain within the TRATON Workshop Suite**.

  

Our solutions enable workshop technicians to perform software updates on vehicles, making our work both technically challenging and directly connected to the end-user experience. We develop across frontend, backend and cloud services and collaborate closely with other TWS teams whose capabilities together enable the complete workshop solution.

  

Jaguar is one of several teams that together develop the TRATON Workshop Suite. We have clear ownership of our domain while depending on and contributing to the wider TWS ecosystem. Close collaboration across team boundaries is therefore a natural part of how we work.

  

Within Jaguar, we work closely together and share responsibility for what we build and operate. **Different experiences, perspectives and strengths make the team better**, and we help each other solve problems, share knowledge and learn along the way. We want an environment where people feel comfortable asking questions, contributing ideas and challenging existing solutions constructively.

  

We strive to work in an **agile and iterative way**, with close collaboration, shared ownership and continuous improvement. As a team, we plan, build, evaluate, learn and adjust together, continuously looking for ways to improve both our solutions and how we work.

  

Joining Team Jaguar means becoming part of a collaborative team where you can work across the full technology stack, **broaden your skills across frontend, backend and cloud development**, and contribute to solutions with a clear impact on workshop operations.

  

As part of the wider **TRATON Workshop Suite development organization**, you will also be exposed to different technical domains, technologies and challenges, creating opportunities to broaden your experience and continue developing over time. You will have opportunities to learn from others, share your own expertise and grow together with the team as we continue developing the TRATON Workshop Suite.

**TRATON Offers**
-----------------

We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.

  

With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, TRATON Group R&D supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.

  

Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. We also arrange events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.

**Application**

We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.

  

Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-10-19. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check is required for this role.

jobs.title: Software Engineer / AI Engineer
jobs.description:
We're growing our engineering team and looking for both Software Engineers and AI Engineers to help build the next generation of Aleido's platform. Whether your strength is solid, scalable software or applying AI to real products, you'll join a team where AI isn't a side project. It's built into what we deliver and how we build it.

**About the role**

You'll work on Aleido's modular platform for product information, used by some of the world's leading industrial companies to create, manage and deliver technical content. You'll own work from specification to deployment, contribute to technical decisions and help shape how we engineer as a team.

**You'll join us in one of two directions:**

* As a Software Engineer, you'll focus on building high-quality features across the platform: APIs, cloud services and modular architecture on Azure and .NET.

* As an AI Engineer, you'll focus on bringing AI into the platform and our products: LLM-powered features, agent integrations, automation and tooling that turns AI capabilities into measurable customer value.

Both directions share the same foundation and work closely together.

**What you'll do**

* Own development tasks from specification to deployment.

* Write high-quality, scalable and maintainable code, using AI-assisted development to work faster without compromising quality.

* Contribute to design and architecture discussions and propose technical solutions.

* Perform thorough code reviews and contrubute to overall code validation and quality practices.

* Collaborate closely with Product Owners and UX to refine requirements.

* Support platform operations, monitoring and troubleshooting.

* Improve workflows, documentation and engineering standards, including how we work with AI.

* Stay curious about new technologies and help keep our solutions ahead of the curve.

**Who you are**

We believe that you have:

* A strong understanding of software engineering, cloud services and distributed systems.

* Good experience with Azure, .NET or an equivalent modern tech stack.

* An understanding of CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and observability.

* A clear grasp of API design, modular architecture and platform patterns.

* Hands-on experience using AI tools in your development work, and genuine interest in where this technology is heading.

* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, and a sense of ownership for what you deliver.

* Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

* Fluency in English, written and spoken.

For the AI Engineer direction, we also expect experience building with LLMs, AI services or frameworks (e.g. Anthropic, OpenAI or Azure AI services), and with integrating AI capabilities into .NET applications.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Azure cloud platform.

* Familiarity of AI/ML-enabled systems, including information flow, uncertainty and error propagation, common failure modes, and approaches to troubleshooting and debugging.

* Experience with agentic workflows, MCP or other AI integration patterns.

* Understanding of business process mapping and optimization techniques.

* Familiarity with content management, technical documentation or aftermarket information.

**Who we are**

Aleido is a Swedish international company with a long heritage of driving the development of product information and learning solutions. Our customers develop complex products or systems, or seek knowledge and confidence to create lasting change, within a wide range of industries including automotive, telecom, advanced machinery, rail and medtech. We are almost a thousand colleagues in five countries. Together we bridge the gap between technology and the people who depend on it – by making the advanced simply understood.

You'll be part of a tight-knit and innovative team where your work truly makes a difference. We believe in empowering people, embracing creativity and constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible with software and AI.

You will play a key role in designing, extending, and delivering modern business applications built on Microsoft Dataverse, Dynamics 365 (CE/CRM), Model-Driven Apps, Power Apps, Power Automate, and Azure integration services.

You’ll work closely with solution architects, functional consultants, developers, and client stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable, supportable solutions. You will also act as a trusted advisor to clients, helping shape solution direction and drive platform adoption.

* Build and enhance Model-Driven Apps, Canvas Apps, Power Automate flows, Power Pages, and PCF controls where required.
* Implement Dataverse data models, business rules, security roles, environment strategies, and ALM processes.

* Support project planning, estimation, sprint planning, and quality assurance.
* Mentor consultants and developers in solution design, configuration, and technical standards.
* Identify delivery risks and help define mitigation strategies.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

**Required:**

* 5+ years implementing Dynamics 365 CE / Power Platform solutions.
* Strong hands-on configuration experience with:
* Model-Driven Apps & Dataverse
* Power Automate
* Security / Environment / Solution Management
* Experience designing or integrating Azure cloud services (e.g., Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, API Management).
* Solid understanding of C# & .NET, Dataverse plugin development, JavaScript form customisation, and REST APIs.
* Experience working in Agile / sprint-based delivery.
* Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills.

**Advantageous (nice-to-have, not required):**

* Power Pages design and governance
* Power Apps Component Framework (PCF) experience

* Familiarity with Azure DevOps, CI/CD for Power Platform solutions (Pipelines / Git Repos)

**What You Bring**

You combine technical depth with strong consulting and communication skills. You’re comfortable translating business needs into clear solution designs and you can guide customers through platform possibilities and constraints. You’re collaborative, hands-on, and motivated to deliver solutions that work and last.

### **About Codec**

Established over 40 years ago, Codec is a multi-award-winning Microsoft Solutions Partner, trusted by public and private sector organisations to deliver impactful digital transformation. Our customer base, revenues and average contract values have grown steadily year on year and we continue to invest in the provision of new product and service offerings.  
  
Our team is a careful mix of recent graduates and experienced professionals from a variety of diverse cultural backgrounds. jobs.description:
* Application Deadline: Oct. 25, 2026

**THE OPPORTUNITY IN A NUTSHELL**

**You?** Empathetic with the people you work with, proactive about the work itself, and creative about how you solve it. Your passion is squashing bug classes at scale and helping developers without blocking them

**Role?** As a **Security Engineer**, you will own application security work end to end: bug bounty triage, code scanning, vulnerability management, and incidents. AI agents are a big part of how we scale that work. You will use them every day and help build new ones.

**Tech stack?** Our marketplaces run on **Java/Kotlin, JavaScript/TypeScript, C# and Go**, and some teams even use Haskell. We run on **AWS and GCP**, and most apps deploy to Kubernetes. We build our agents with whichever models fit the job best

**Location?**Join us in our **Stockholm, Oslo, or Aarhus** office with the flexibility to work 3 days per week remotely.

**Company?** **Vend,** home of **FINN, Blocket, Tori, Oikotie, DBA and Bilbasen**. Around 500 developers deploy code to production several thousand times a week.

**Why us?** Most security teams are still deciding what to do with LLMs. We have spent a year running agents on production security work and measuring what actually helps. You will join while we are still working out the methods, and help shape them.

Sounds like your cup of tea? Check out the details below!

**WHO ARE YOU?**

* **Security Experience:** You have found and fixed vulnerabilities in real applications. You are comfortable in code you did not write, and can tell an impactful finding from noise.
* **Engineering Background:** You have shipped code to production. You would rather build the thing that prevents a bug class, or the agent that finds it, than write the report about it.
* **Hands-on with AI:** You already use LLMs in your daily work and want to push them further, by giving agents tools, context and harder problems. Experience building agents is a plus, but not required.
* **Fast Learner:** You pick up new, complex topics quickly. In this field, what worked six months ago might not be the best approach today.
* **English Fluency:** You write and speak English well. It is the working language across our teams in Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Poland, and Finland.
* **Education:** A degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. We value different paths into security.

**WHAT'S THE JOB LIKE?**

**Day-to-day work**

We used to automate with code. Now we automate with reasoning. Security scanners find patterns, but confirming a real risk takes investigation: tracing a request across services, finding who owns them, checking how they are exposed, reading logs, and testing whether an attack works. We are teaching agents to do more of that investigation, so you can spend your time on the findings that matter.

**The Product Security Team**

We are seven people spread across the Nordics, and we meet up regularly to work together. We are part of the Delivery Platforms area in Vend. Core Delivery Platforms helps Vend create real value by turning delivery into a trusted, measurable flow. We build composable, self-serve platform capabilities and provide services that reduce friction and power the flow that connects build, data, and AI, so ideas become outcomes faster.
  
  
If you want to learn more about Emil and the team, you can follow this Link here: vend.com/news/inside-vends-product-security-team-a-year-of-ai-agents-on-our-production-systems

**Emil Vaagland,** Head of Product Security, is happy to provide information about the daily work and answer any questions you may have about the role, you can reach out via email: emil.vaagland@vend.com. For the recruitment process and other topics, you can reach out to **Clayton Don Corda,** Senior TA Partner, via clayton.don.corda@vend.com

* Learn smarter, with our AI powered Learning Lab
* Work with products that matter in people's lives
* 1700 fantastic colleagues in 4 Nordic countries
* Smart choices made easy on our marketplaces
* Innovation, it’s at our core

**About the company**
---------------------

**At Vend, our mission is simple: Smart choices made easy.**

We’re here to make sustainable living effortless through seamless digital experiences. As part of a dynamic family of marketplaces, including FINN, Blocket, Tori, Bytbil, Oikotie, Bilbasen, and DBA, we connect people with services and products that matter.

Driven by purpose and curiosity, we constantly evolve to meet today’s needs and shape a smarter, more sustainable tomorrow.

* Gather and translate customer and sales requirements into technical specifications
* Design, implement, and test new functionality using modern software technologies
* Integrate third‑party automation tools and ensure compatibility with existing systems
* Collaborate with cross‑functional teams including sales, engineering and after market
* Maintain product documentation, release notes, and technical manuals
* Provide technical support and troubleshooting for deployed solutions
* Drive continuous improvement and adopt best practices in software engineering
* Align product roadmap with NOV’s strategic objectives and market demands

* Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and software development methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum
* Proven track record of delivering complex software products on schedule

* Ability to work in a multinational, matrix‑organized environment

jobs.title: Senior Observability Engineer
jobs.description:
**Responsibilities:**  
Administer the log and search platform (currently Splunk Cloud): indexes, data onboarding, roles and access, apps and knowledge objects, retention, and search and dashboard performance. Monitor ingest latency, skipped searches and licence consumption, and tune to keep cost under control.
  
  
Administer the APM, RUM and infrastructure monitoring platform (currently Splunk Observability Cloud): teams, tokens, integrations, detectors, alert routing and dashboards. Manage metric cardinality and usage against entitlement.
  
  
**Roll out telemetry to all IS applications:** OpenTelemetry Collector (currently the Splunk distribution) on AWS EKS and EC2, and APM instrumentation for Java, Go, .NET, Node.js and Python. Keep instrumentation vendor-neutral where possible so the backend can change without re-instrumenting. Maintain onboarding guides and report coverage per application.
  
  
Set up RUM for customer-facing web and mobile frontends and link browser sessions to backend traces, logs and infrastructure metrics, so an incident can be followed from the user to the data store.
  
  
Build and maintain observability as code (Terraform or equivalent) in Git with peer review and CI/CD, so detectors, dashboards and configuration are versioned, repeatable and free of manual drift.
  
  
**Plan and run platform and agent upgrades with vendors:** define the test plan, validate in non-production, sign off before release, and manage support cases and escalations. Run structured evaluations and proofs of concept when StarHub considers a new or replacement tool.
  
  
Design, build and operate AI and agent-assisted observability workflows, such as alert noise reduction, automated triage, root-cause summaries and natural-language querying, with human review and guardrails.
  
  
Apply controls aligned with MAS-TRM and CSA best practices to telemetry: retention, access control, audit logging, and masking of PII and sensitive data before ingest.
  
  
Perform User Access Reviews (UAR) on the observability platforms at least twice a year, covering user accounts, roles and tokens, and follow up on removals and exceptions. Participate in company-wide audits when required, providing evidence and closing findings on time.
  
  
Qualifications
  
  
**Minimum Profile/ Track Record:**  
Desired Background
  
  
Experience in medium-to-large technology, telecommunications or financial services organizations with complex hybrid-cloud environments and many application teams; has owned an enterprise observability platform, not only used one.
  
  
Seniority, Skills, Certifications (must-haves)
  
  
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field.
  
  
5+ years of relevant experience in observability, monitoring, SRE or platform engineering, including hands-on administration, optimization and health monitoring of an enterprise observability or log analytics platform. Splunk (Cloud or Enterprise) is strongly preferred.
  
  
Hands-on experience with an enterprise APM/RUM/infrastructure monitoring platform across RUM, APM, infrastructure and data-storage monitoring. Splunk Observability Cloud is preferred; Datadog, Dynatrace, New Relic, Elastic or similar is acceptable. Clear understanding of distributed tracing from frontend to backend.
  
  
Experience installing and operating OpenTelemetry-based telemetry on AWS (EKS, EC2) for Java, Go, .NET, Node.js and Python applications.
  
  
Experience managing observability configuration as code (Terraform or equivalent, Git, CI/CD).
  
  
Prior AI delivery experience in observability or IT operations: has taken an AI or agent-based capability into production use by operations or engineering teams.
  
  
Familiarity with security and compliance standards (MAS-TRM, CSA), including telemetry data governance.
  
  
**Certifications are a plus:** Splunk Core Certified Admin or Power User, Splunk Observability Cloud certification, or equivalent vendor certifications on another observability platform.
  
  
Ideal track record #1
  
  
Owned an enterprise observability or log analytics platform at scale (Splunk preferred) as administrator and platform owner, improving search performance, stability or ingest cost, and ran vendor-led upgrades with test and validation plans and no unplanned outage.
  
  
Ideal track record #2
  
  
Rolled out APM and infrastructure telemetry (OpenTelemetry) across a large application estate with RUM-to-backend tracing in use during real incidents, measurably reducing time to detect or resolve.
  
  
Ideal track record #3
  
  
Delivered an AI or agent-based capability in production for monitoring, triage or root-cause analysis, with measurable impact such as less alert noise or faster resolution.

jobs.title: .NET Full Stack Developer (Managed Services)
jobs.description:
**About AvePoint:**

Securing the Future. AvePoint is a global leader in data management and data governance, and over 21,000 customers worldwide rely on our solutions to modernize the digital workplace across Microsoft, Google, Salesforce and other collaboration environments. AvePoint's global channel partner program includes over 3,500 managed service providers, value added resellers and systems integrators, with our solutions available in more than 100 cloud marketplaces. To learn more, visit **www.avepoint.com**.

At AvePoint, we are committed to investing in our people. Agility, passion and teamwork set us up to do our best work and foster a culture where you are empowered to craft your career, make an impact, and own (y)our future. Unleash the power of you!

**About the role:**

As a **.NET Full Stack Developer**, you will design and develop scalable web applications using C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, RESTful APIs, React and TypeScript. You'll work closely with our development team and customers to deliver robust technical solutions and support end-to-end project delivery.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Design, build and maintain scalable full-stack web applications using C#, ASP.NET Core, RESTful APIs and a modern JavaScript front-end framework, like React and TypeScript.
* Develop and integrate RESTful APIs and back-end services, including data modelling with Entity Framework Core and relational databases.
* Contribute to solution architecture and technical design discussions with the development team, including application structure, API design, data modelling, integration patterns and technology selection.
* Work with customers to understand, quantify and verify their business needs and use cases, and translate them into technical solutions
* Write clean, maintainable, tested code and review code from fellow team members
* Troubleshoot application, integration, database and infrastructure issues across development, testing and production environments.
* Work closely with the customer's team throughout delivery

**The ideal candidate has:**

* 4+ years of hands-on software development experience, mostly in full-stack .NET web development
* Strong C# and .NET skills, including ASP.NET Core and Web API
* Experience building modern web applications using JavaScript/TypeScript and React.js or a comparable modern front-end framework.
* Strong knowledge of relational databases such as SQL Server or PostgreSQL, including data modelling and SQL query development.
* Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs and integrating with external systems.
* Experience with Git, code review practices and CI/CD pipelines
* Experience with Azure or AWS, with Azure experience preferred.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across application, database and integration layers.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Self-motivated and comfortable working in a fast-moving, client-facing delivery environment.
* Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering or a related discipline preferred.

  

**About AvePoint**

Check out our careers blog for content on our people, culture, and workplace!

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Any personal data you share with us during the application process will be processed strictly in compliance with applicable data protection laws and our Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Technical Engineer/Technical Specialist
jobs.description:
Technical Engineer / Technical Specialist

**Location:** AMK  
**Working Hours:** Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM – 6:00 PM  
**Salary:** $2,400 - $4,000

**Job Overview**

We are seeking a **Technical Engineer / Technical Specialist with AI competencies** to support the development, implementation and maintenance of digital learning applications, including Learning Management Systems (LMS) and other learning technology platforms.

The role combines software development, system integration and AI technologies to enhance learning platforms, improve user experience, personalise learning pathways and strengthen platform capabilities.

The ideal candidate will have strong software engineering skills, experience with learning technology platforms and practical knowledge of AI tools and technologies.

**Key Responsibilities**

Learning Application Development

* Develop, customise and maintain Learning Management Systems (LMS) and other digital learning platforms.
* Support the implementation, configuration and deployment of learning technologies.
* Ensure applications are scalable, secure and aligned with established system architecture standards.

AI Integration & Development

* Design and integrate AI-powered features such as recommendation engines, chatbots and adaptive learning tools.
* Integrate AI frameworks and APIs to support learning analytics, learner engagement and personalisation.
* Explore and implement AI-driven solutions for content discovery, learner support and performance tracking.

System Integration

* Integrate LMS platforms with enterprise systems such as HR, authentication and analytics platforms using APIs and middleware.
* Support integration between different applications and systems.
* Ensure compatibility with e-learning standards such as SCORM, xAPI and LTI.

Testing & Optimisation

* Conduct system testing, debugging and performance optimisation for application and AI components.
* Monitor platform performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues during implementation and deployment.

Collaboration

* Work closely with instructional designers, project managers and product teams to translate learning requirements into technical solutions.
* Collaborate with data engineers and AI specialists to implement machine learning models and intelligent features.
* Work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Documentation & Support

* Maintain technical documentation covering system architecture, integrations and AI components.
* Provide technical troubleshooting and support during system implementation and deployment.
* Ensure system configurations and integrations are properly documented and maintained.

**Skills & Experience**

* Experience in software development using languages such as **Python, JavaScript, C# or Java**.
* Good knowledge of web technologies including **HTML5, CSS and REST APIs**.
* Familiarity with microservices architecture.
* Experience working with **Learning Management Systems (LMS)** or digital learning platforms.
* Hands-on experience with relational databases such as **Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL or PostgreSQL**.

AI & Data

* Familiarity with AI/ML frameworks such as **TensorFlow, PyTorch or Scikit-learn**.
* Experience integrating AI APIs or services, including NLP, recommendation engines or chatbot frameworks.
* Understanding of learning analytics, data processing and AI-driven personalisation.

Systems & Integration

* Experience integrating enterprise systems through APIs or middleware.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as **AWS, Azure or Google Cloud**.
* Familiarity with **SCORM, xAPI, LTI** or other digital learning standards will be an advantage.
* Knowledge of system administration, including user access management, data backup and security practices in cloud environments.

Other Skills

* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Good attention to detail when handling configurations, customisations and system integrations.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work effectively in cross-functional project teams.

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline.
* Relevant certifications in AI, cloud platforms, software engineering or LMS technologies will be an advantage.
* Experience working with AWS, Azure or Google Cloud in learning technology environments.
* Experience with SCORM, xAPI or Tin Can API for learning activity tracking and reporting.
* Knowledge of data security practices, particularly for sensitive learning and employee data.
* Experience working with cloud-based learning platforms.

Pay: $2,600.00 - $4,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Python/DevSecOps Engineer - od backendu až po CI/CD a security
jobs.description:
**Do** našeho **DevSecOps týmu hledáme posilu, která se bude věnovat především vývoji webových aplikací v Pythonu** a zároveň jí nejsou cizí ani témata jako **CI/CD, kontejnerizace nebo security.**

**Nemusíš být expert(ka) – hledáme především někoho, kdo má dobrý technický základ, aktivně využívá AI nástroje, dokáže převzít odpovědnost a pracovat samostatně.**

Pokud tě láká prostředí, kde se učíš praxí, **čti dál!**

### **Čemu se budeš věnovat:**

* Vývoji backendu webových aplikací v Pythonu a návrhu REST API
* Návrhu datových modelů a práci s databází MongoDB
* Zpracování a generování tabulkových dokumentů
* Automatizaci vývoje, testování a nasazování
* Řešení problémů napříč backendem, frontendem, databází i provozním prostředím

### **Budeme si rozumět, pokud:**

* Máš praktické zkušenosti s Pythonem a backendovým vývojem webových aplikací
* Znáš Django nebo obdobný Python framework a rozumíš návrhu REST API
* Umíš pracovat se strukturovanými daty (validace, serializace, tabulkové dokumenty)
* Už jsi pracoval(a) s dokumentovou databází (ideálně MongoDB) a zvládneš navrhnout datový model i efektivní dotazy
* Ovládáš velmi dobře Git včetně týmového workflow a dokážeš automatizovat vývoj, testování i nasazování
* Prakticky používáš Docker ke kontejnerizaci aplikací a pohybuješ se v Linuxu/Unixu (stačí i WSL)
* Orientuješ se v CI/CD a principech DevSecOps a zajímá tě bezpečnost aplikací, závislostí, konfigurace i citlivých údajů
* AI nástroje využíváš jako pomocníka k vyšší efektivitě, ne jako náhradu vlastní práce – rozumíš tomu, co s AI vytváříš, a odpovídáš za finální výsledek

#### **Neméně důležité je pro nás, pokud:**

* Jsi proaktivní, máš vlastní iniciativu a úkoly dotahuješ do konce
* U chyb hledáš skutečnou příčinu, umíš srozumitelně popsat problém i navrhnout řešení
* Komunikuješ otevřeně a včas dáš vědět, když se něco zasekne
* Chceš se učit nové technologie a zpětnou vazbu bereš jako příležitost se posunout

#### **Výhodu budeš mít, pokud:**

* Máš zkušenost s automatizovaným testováním
* Orientuješ se v moderním frontendu (TypeScript, React) včetně nástrojů pro správu serverového stavu, formulářů a monorepozitářů
* Nezalekneš se kódu v .NET – stačí mu rozumět, vyvíjet v něm nemusíš
* Máš zkušenost s integrací více technologických platforem

### **Proč věříme, že ti v Adastře bude dobře:**

* Jsme **stabilní mezinárodní firma s multiprojektovým prostředím, která pořád roste**
* Pod jednou střechou **sdružujeme špičkové technologie a zkušené experty** ze všech možných IT odvětví
* Podporujeme **individuální profesní rozvoj**
* **Jednáme spolu na rovinu** a ceníme si proaktivního přístupu

#### **Mimo to se můžeš těšit na:**

* **Neformální atmosféru** – po práci se potkáváme na společenských i sportovních akcích (a těch není zrovna málo)
* **Moderní kanceláře** v **Mississippi House** **v Karlíně**
* **25 dnů volna do začátku** a **každý rok** ti k nim přidáme **jeden den volna navíc**
* **Flexibilní pracovní dobu i home office** – vše podle domluvy
* **Široké možnosti vzdělávání** – tréninky, přednášky, webináře i certifikace
* Měsíční **příspěvek do Cafeterie**, který můžeš využít na různé volnočasové aktivity **nebo na Multisport kartu**
* **Příspěvek na stravování**
* V kuchyňkách najdeš **výbornou kávu, velký výběr čajů i jiné nápoje + ovocné a svačinové bedýnky plné dobrot**
* **Slevy u našich partnerů** – ať už jde o elektroniku, kulturu či služby
* **Dny FIT Adastra**, protože nám záleží na tvém zdraví – můžeš využít odborná vyšetření, konzultace a různé aktivity pro podporu fyzické i psychické kondice
* Rádi podporujeme, když chceš pomáhat, takže dostaneš 1 den placeného volna navíc na dobrovolnické aktivity dle svého výběru
* Placené volno navíc, pokud doprovázíš svého prvňáčka v první školní den
* Chceš procestovat svět, napsat knihu nebo si jen dát pauzu? **Po 3 letech u nás si můžeš vzít Sabbatical leave**
* **Štědrý referral program**, pokud nám pomůžeš najít nové Adastřany

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**

**nShift** is the leading global provider of cloud delivery management solutions (SaaS), we enable the frictionless shipment and return of almost one billion shipments across 190 countries each year. We are headquartered in London and Oslo and have over 460 employees across offices in Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark, the United Kingdom, Poland, the Netherlands, Belgium, and Romania.

Our software is used by many of the world leading e-commerce, retail, manufacturing, and 3PL shippers due to us having over 1000 carriers integrated into our platform, nearly 3 times more than our competitors!

If you buy goods online, there is a strong chance that nShift has powered that delivery, so come and join us as we shape the future of shipping, one frictionless journey at a time.

**About you**

You're an engineering leader who still enjoys being close to the code. You care about your people as much as about the product, and you're comfortable balancing delivery, quality, and team growth.

You are someone who:

* Builds and leads a high-performing team of developers and testers, with clear expectations and regular feedback
* Knows the status of every commitment the team has made, and acts early when something slips
* Holds a high bar for the team's work and your own, raised through clear expectations and direct feedback
* Communicates openly and clearly with the team, stakeholders, and management, including when the message is difficult
* Acts in the best interest of the company and the team when making tough decisions

**Purpose of role**

At nShift, the Engineering Manager's primary task is to lead, hold accountable, and deliver through a group of talented developers and testers, ensuring they thrive in a collaborative, high-performing environment.
  
You are part of the product trio together with the Product Manager and the Designer, aligning business goals, customer needs, and technical solutions. You are the team's voice to the wider organization and bring company priorities back to the team clearly and honestly.

**Your role includes:**

* Collaborating with the product trio to balance feature delivery with quality
* Supporting team development and maintaining a high-performing culture
* Communicating company goals and representing the team within the organization
* Owning delivery predictability and the team's say/do ratio, alongside technical excellence

**What you'll be doing**

**Technology**

* Ensure that daily work aligns with the tech vision, guiding principles, and minimum quality standards, including monitoring code quality through tools like SonarQube.
* Take part in design and architecture discussions, and review code regularly enough to have an informed view of quality and risk.
* Challenge estimates and technical approaches, drawing on your own engineering experience.
* Make sure that the technology managed by the team is resilient, secure, and up to date.
* Promote internal education, collaboration, and knowledge-sharing across platforms and teams.

**Process**

* Challenge your team to enhance their working methods, proactively addressing opportunities and obstacles with a critical mindset.
* Ensure that your team follows established processes, such as Kanban, Scrum and test management, in service of predictable delivery, and advocate for adopting best practices and tools.
* Own the team's delivery commitments. Track planned versus delivered work each sprint and quarter, report honestly on the gap, and drive corrective action.
* Identify blockers, dependencies and risks early, and resolve or escalate them before they affect delivery.

**People Management**

* Administer and oversee personal development plans, salary structures, and recruitment processes.
* Create opportunities for team members to stay motivated through mentorship, coaching, or delegating tasks to encourage professional growth.
* Set clear expectations for each engineer and manage performance against them, setting an example for your team to follow.
* Build and maintain a robust team with overlapping skills and knowledge, avoiding critical dependencies on single individuals.

**What you will bring**

This is a **hands-on management role**: you will know what your team is building, why it is late when it is late, and what you are doing about it. For our Data Exchange team, we are seeking candidates who embody the following characteristics:

**Technical Proficiency: A strong hands-on background in C# is required, with a proven history of technical expertise in software development**. Experience with front-end development frameworks is a plus, but not mandatory.

**Delivery Ownership:** A track record of teams that ship what they commit to, and comfort using metrics such as cycle time, sprint predictability, and say/do ratio to run the team.

**Professional:** You understand that it’s a part of a manager’s role to look out for the interest of the company, and you are prepared to manage difficult tasks with this in mind.

**Exacting Standards:** Maintaining high standards is vital as you consistently aim for excellence in both personal performance and the work produced by your team.

**Effective Communication:** Proficiency in both written and spoken English is essential for ensuring seamless communication within the team and with stakeholders.

**Requirements**

**The technologies this team uses are:**

* C#, .NET, .NET Core, React native, Vue.js
* PostgreSQL
* Docker, Bitbucket
* AWS, IaC
* SonarQube, JFrog

**Education and experience**

* BS degree in Computer Science or related field
* Minimum of 5 years as a hands-on engineer, plus 2-3 years of management experience

**Language Skills**

* Fluency in English is mandatory (written and spoken)

At nShift, we believe in embracing diversity in all forms and fostering an inclusive environment for everyone, which we believe is essential for our continued success. We're an equal opportunity employer, meaning all applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity, or disability status.

* 25 years of experience in software engineering, established in Vienna, Austria

* Active in Romania since 2007, with office in central Bucharest (Bd. Iancu de Hunedoara 54B)

* Delivering End to End IT Consulting Services - From Team Augmentation and Dedicated Teams to Custom Software Development

* We deliver scalable enterprise systems, intelligent automation frameworks, and digital transformation platforms

* Cross-industry experience by sustaining global players in BSFI (Banking, financial services and insurance), Telecom,Retail & E-commerce, Energy and Utilities, Automotive, Manufacturing, Logitics, High Tech

* Global Presence: Switzerland, Germany, Austria, Sweden, Hungary, Slovakia, Serbia, Romania, and Indonesia

* International team of 500+ software engineers

* Strategic partnerships: Microsoft Cloud Certified Partner, Tricentis Solutions Partner in Test Automation and Test Management, Creatio Exclusive Partner, Doxee Implementation Partner

* Powered by cutting-edge technologies: AI, Data & Analytics, Cloud, DevOps, IoT, and Test Automation.

* Project beneficiaries ranging from large-scale enterprises to startups

* Stable growth and revenue increase year over year, a resilient organisation in volatile IT market conditions

* Quality-first mindset, culture of innovation, and long-term client partnerships

* Global and local reach – trusted by key industry players in Europe and the US

### **Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain features across backend and frontend applications.

* Develop backend services and REST APIs using .NET and C#.

* Develop responsive web applications and reusable components using Angular and TypeScript.

* Design and maintain application logic and database integrations using SQL-based relational databases.

* Write clean, maintainable, secure, and testable code following team development standards.

* Effectively use GitHub Copilot and other approved AI-assisted development tools to improve coding, testing, refactoring, and development productivity while ensuring code quality and correctness.

* Analyze requirements and translate business needs into appropriate technical solutions.

* Troubleshoot and resolve application defects, performance issues, and production incidents.

* Review code and contribute to improving code quality, architecture, and development practices.

* Write and maintain unit and integration tests and support QA activities.

* Participate in application modernization and refactoring of existing components.

* Consider performance, scalability, security, and multi-tenant requirements when developing new functionality.

* Collaborate with Product, QA, DBA, and DevOps teams throughout development, testing, deployment, and production support.

### **Qualifications**

* 5 years of experience with C#, .NET / .NET Core, and ASP.NET Core.

* 3 years of experience with Angular, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.

* Proven experience in enterprise-level software development (experience with high-performance applications)

* Practical experience using GitHub Copilot to support coding, refactoring, testing, code review, and technical problem-solving, while maintaining responsibility for code quality and correctness.

* Experience designing and consuming REST APIs.

* Good knowledge of relational databases, Microsoft SQL, data modeling, and database access from .NET applications.

* Good understanding of object-oriented programming, design patterns, and clean-code practices.

* Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.

* Experience with unit testing, debugging, and application troubleshooting.

* Understanding of web application security, authentication, authorization, and role-based access.

* Understanding of multi-tenant SaaS application concepts and scalable application design.

* Ability to analyze technical problems and work independently on moderately complex development tasks.

* Good communication, collaboration, and documentation skills.

**What We Offer**

* Premium medical package

* Lunch Tickets & Pluxee Card

* Bookster subscription

* 13th salary/yearly bonuses

* Enterprise job security with a startup mentality (diverse & engaging environment, international exposure, flat hierarchy) under the stability of a secure multinational

* A supportive culture (we value ownership, autonomy, and healthy work-life balance) with great colleagues, team events and activities

* Flexible working program and openness to remote work

* Collaborative mindset – employees shape their own benefits, tools, team events and internal practices

* Diverse opportunities in Software Development with international exposure

* Flexibility to choose projects aligned with your career path and technical goals

* Access to leading learning platforms, courses, and certifications (Pluralsight, Udemy, Microsoft, Google Cloud)

* Career growth & learning – mentorship programs, certifications, professional development opportunities, and above-market salary

jobs.title: Director of Engineering - MetaDefender Email Security
jobs.description:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world's critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

**Director of Engineering — MetaDefender Email Security**

**Reports to: VP, Products**

**Protecting the World's Critical Infrastructure**

OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage they need to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Trusted by more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions worldwide — including many of the world's largest governments, utilities, financial institutions, and defense contractors — OPSWAT protects the systems that keep society running.

**The Product: MetaDefender Email Security**

MetaDefender Email Security is OPSWAT's email threat prevention portfolio, trusted by governments and critical infrastructure operators to stop file-borne and email-borne threats before they reach the inbox. It comprises two complementary products designed for different environments and customer profiles — MetaDefender Email Gateway Security, deployed on-premises in front of existing mail servers, and MetaDefender Cloud Email Security, which augments Microsoft 365 — each embedding OPSWAT's threat prevention technology, including Deep CDR, Metascan Multiscanning, Proactive DLP, and Predictive Alin AI, directly into the mail flow.

This role owns the engineering for the products across both deployment models — the on-premises gateway and the cloud-native Microsoft 365 service — each with its own security, assurance, and operational demands, and all built to scale.

**About This Role**

We are looking for a Director of Engineering who leads from the front. This is a hands-on, technically-centric leadership role — not a pure people-management position — with full accountability for the engineering of the MetaDefender Email Security: architecture, delivery, quality, and the teams that build it. You will lead engineering across multiple deployment form factors — from air-gapped high security environments to native-cloud deployments — operating with the rigor of a principal engineer and the clarity of an executive.

You are an AI-native engineering leader. You have personally orchestrated fleets of AI agents to architect, build, test, and ship production systems, and you have launched and released real products through a full AI-powered software development lifecycle (SDLC) — from specification and code generation to automated testing, review, and deployment. Product Management defines what to ship; you define how to build it. You own the end-to-end delivery of the roadmap Product Management sets, hold the delivery bar, and build a high-performance culture the rest of OPSWAT's engineering portfolio will look to as a model for AI-native development. You report to the VP, Products and lead a distributed team across Romania and Hungary, while the role itself can be based anywhere — with a preference for the UK, USA, or near an OPSWAT-operated location.

**What You Will Be Doing**

* **Lead as an AI-first effort:** make AI agents a first-class part of how the team works — orchestrating agents to create specs, generate code and tests, verify results, and run reviews — while ensuring humans own and validate every line that ships. Treat automation and intelligence as the default, not the exception.
* **Stay hands-on:** remain directly in the codebase — setting architecture patterns, writing and reviewing critical code, prototyping, and unblocking hard technical problems. You lead by doing, not only by delegating.
* **Own end-to-end delivery of the roadmap:** take full ownership of delivering the product roadmap set by Product Management — turning the "what to ship" into the "how to build," and owning execution sequencing, technical risk, quality, security, and release across every deployment form factor.
* **Set technical direction (the "how"):** drive the architecture and technology choices that underpin a product serving high-assurance environments at scale. Hold a strong engineering point of view and be willing to defend it.
* **Build and lead a high-performance team:** recruit, develop, and retain top engineers and their leads across Romania and Hungary; create clear career paths and norms for code quality and review; and build a culture where strong engineers want to stay and grow.
* **Drive performance-based management:** set clear, measurable expectations and run a rigorous, fair performance culture — recognizing and accelerating top performers, raising the bar continuously, and addressing underperformance decisively by coaching where there is a path and upgrading or exiting the role where there is not.
* **Hold a security-first quality bar:** champion code review with a security lens for both human-written and AI-generated code, catching injection risks, insecure defaults, missing validation, and privilege-escalation vectors in file-handling and authentication paths before they ship.
* **Raise engineering velocity:** continuously improve how the team works — CI/CD pipelines, AI-assisted development workflows, incident response, and operational maturity — so the team ships faster and more reliably over time.
* **Codify AI-native practices for the portfolio:** establish the playbooks, AI context files, coding harnesses, test frameworks, and review norms developed on this product so other OPSWAT product teams can adopt them.
* **Partner cross-functionally:** work shoulder-to-shoulder with the VP, Products, plus Product Management, Design, and security leaders — turning the product roadmap (the what) into engineering execution (the how), committing to scope and timelines, and pushing back clearly when trade-offs require it.

**What We Need From You**

* **Full agentic development experience (required):** You have personally run a full agentic, AI-powered SDLC end-to-end — and have done so in B2B and high-security enterprise environments where compliance, data sensitivity, and assurance requirements are non-negotiable. You can show real work (PRs, commit history, shipped products, or a portfolio) where agentic workflows drove delivery — not slideware about AI.
* **A product launched via a full AI-powered SDLC:** demonstrable experience taking a product from spec to release using an end-to-end AI-assisted lifecycle (spec generation, code/test generation, automated verification, AI-assisted review, and CI/CD), with you accountable for the outcome.
* **Proven engineering leadership:** 8+ years of software engineering experience and 3+ years leading engineering teams (including managing managers/leads) through complex product delivery at scale. You can point to the decisions you made and why.
* **Performance-based leadership:** a track record of building high-performing teams through rigorous, fair performance management — promoting excellence, making timely talent decisions, and reducing or replacing low performers when needed.
* **Deep technical excellence:** strong, current software engineering fundamentals — solid command of design patterns, SOLID principles, and modern architecture. You can evaluate AI-assisted code with the same rigor as human-authored code. AI tools amplify strong fundamentals; they do not replace them.
* **Scalable systems experience:** a proven history building scalable, distributed solutions — including relational/document databases, cloud-native services, and modern CI/CD systems.
* **Quality and test discipline:** a high bar for tested, maintainable code; you use AI to accelerate test scaffolding, then validate that coverage is real and meaningful.
* **Distributed-team leadership:** demonstrated ability to lead and align engineers across countries and time zones, building trust, clarity, and accountability in a remote/hybrid, multi-country setup.
* **Talent magnet and clear communicator:** you identify strong engineers, make a compelling case for why they should join, and create an environment where they do their best work — and you communicate technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders without oversimplifying.
* **Security-conscious by default:** operating in critical infrastructure markets means security is never an afterthought; you hold the team to a security-first bar on design, code review, and incident response.

**It Would Be Nice If You Had**

* **Domain familiarity:** understanding of email as a communication channel and the underlying technology and protocols. Appreciation of the different deployment methods for email security and their characteristics.
* **Cloud services familiarity:** experience of integrating products with M365 and/or Google Workspace and their associated API ecosystems
* **.NET / C# ecosystem:** hands-on or managerial experience with .NET Core / C# — enough to evaluate architectural decisions, review PRs credibly, and hire well for the stack.
* **Cloud-native and containers:** experience leading the design or operation of cloud-native SaaS platforms — Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS/Azure/GCP — including using AI agents to script infrastructure and deployment automation.
* **AI context-file authoring:** experience writing AI context files (e.g., CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, or equivalent) that encode architecture decisions and forbidden patterns for consistent, safe AI output across a team.
* **AI in CI/CD pipelines:** familiarity running AI agents inside pipelines — auto-fixing lint, generating missing tests, or running safe migrations as pipeline steps — not as experiments, but as how the team actually works.
* **International team experience:** a track record of building and maintaining engineering culture and delivery quality across multiple countries and time zones.
* **Async and high-throughput systems:** experience validating concurrency and thread-safety in high-throughput services.

**Why You'll Love Working Here**

* Lead a product trusted by critical infrastructure customers across air-gapped, cross-domain, internet-connected, and native-cloud deployments — the architecture and culture decisions you make now will shape it for years.
* Influence beyond this product: the AI-native patterns you establish will propagate across OPSWAT's engineering portfolio.
* Work from anywhere — a worldwide, remote-friendly role with a preference for the UK, USA, or a location near an OPSWAT-operated country.
* Stable, growing international company with an exceptional customer base across 50+ countries.
* A mandate to build AI-native engineering practices — and the latitude to do it your way.
* Attractive compensation with regular performance assessments and flexibility for the right candidate.

**Ciklum** is looking for a **Support Engineer** to join our team full-time in Romania.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

**About the role:**

As a Support Engineer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow.

Are you looking to advance a career in customer service, and support? Do you have a knack for helping people and an eagerness to problem-solve? Want to be a member of a high-performing customer support center environment? Good news! Our client is looking for a Technical Support Specialist to join their team. Reporting directly to the Technical Support Manager, the Technical Support Specialist will perform first level technical support services for all technology-based commercial services (customer facing solutions). This role will be responding directly to customers' support queries. The Technical Support Specialist will follow a standardized approach to understand the needs of the customer and recommend the proper utilization of the best solution or capability based on those needs. In handling of reported incidents, thorough symptom assessment will be employed to establish the root cause. Using a step-by-step process, this role will guide the customer through problem resolution and/or functional training as appropriate.

**Responsibilities:**

* Ensuring service is provided in accordance with our client's Service Desk Operating Procedures and adheres to defined Service Level Agreements
* Actively seeking to understand the customer’s needs and/or the root cause of the current inbound request
* Acting as a customer advocate and seeking to take ownership of customer inbound requests through resolution
* Managing inbound requests from customers
* Resolving assigned customer inbound requests within established service levels and balancing workload
* Monitoring, balancing, and helping to resolve functional escalations from agents in partner locations
* Actively participating in the Customer Community of our client
* Continuously striving to become a subject matter expert in all customer facing applications and internal service desk tools and technologies
* Following established protocols to escalate appropriate requests to more advanced functions within the service model
* Providing after-hours support for priority incidents as needed

**Requirements:**

* Two-year degree in a technical curriculum preferred
