Software Engineer

  

**Company**

Craneware PLC

  

**Speciality**

Technology

  

**Category**

Permanent

  

**Location Country**

  

**Office Location**

Edinburgh

  

**Additional Locations**

  

**Introduction to Craneware**

Let’s transform the business of healthcare! At The Craneware Group, we are dedicated to empowering our customers with industry-defining insights that pave the way for a brighter future.
  
  
If you are an energetic, forward-thinking individual with a passion for innovation, we invite you to join our thriving team of more than 750 dedicated professionals. Together, we'll fuel the expansion of our SaaS platform and develop cutting-edge applications that redefine the healthcare landscape.
  
  
**For UK Only Postings:** The Craneware Group supports a flexible work environment as well as a collaborative and teamwork focused atmosphere. Employees will be expected to work a hybrid working arrangement spending 40% of their time per month in the Tanfield office - approx 2 days per week.

  

**The Team**

Craneware is looking for passionate Software Engineers to design, develop and deliver high quality software solutions for TCG products which drive improvements in the US-based healthcare market. We are growing a team of strong thinkers and innovators that are willing to work closely with product and customer-facing teams to design and develop new applications in the Cloud.
  
  
We are expanding our current platform and SaaS product offerings by using cutting edge technology to process very large data sets that will provide actionable insights for our customers. Architecting our solutions with a best of breed approach to technology, the .NET platform is leveraged in order to provide the necessary scale and rapidly bring products to market. Innovative, collaborative, and agile are critical skills that our engineering team members must possess in our environment.
  
  
We are interested in finding a skilled Software Engineer to join one of our delivery teams. You’ll be working with a small and friendly agile team of talented software and automation engineers to deliver high quality and elegant cloud-based software solutions that have impact on millions of people, leveraging the Azure platform and latest technologies. This team consumes, transforms and presents pharmacy data which allows our customers to have a meaningful way to view their inventory and benefit from real-time cost analysis.
  
  
Tech Stack:
  
C#, .Net Core
  
Web API, Storage Queues, EventHub
  
Azure Durable and Regular Functions
  
Angular
  
Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Data Lake, Azure Storage (Blob and Table)

  

**You Will Be**

* Working within an Agile delivery team to contribute to the development of core software releases using The Craneware Group Application Lifecycle Management (CALM) methodology.
* Investigating and resolving software defects to provide timely resolutions.
* Ensuring sufficient code coverage of deliverables by the use of automated tests.
* Reviewing peer code against The Craneware Group development standards to ensure high quality code and consistency.
* Working with product management to provide technical solutions to meet product requirements.
* Keeping up to date with technical advances to drive innovation.

  

**You Will Bring**

* Educated to Degree level with 1+ years’ commercial experience working in a Software Development role or 3+ years’ commercial experience working in a Software Development role.
* Development experience in at least one programming language and relevant technologies.
* A good understanding of automated testing methods and their application.
* Working knowledge of Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) tools (e.g. TFS or Jira).
* 1+ years’ experience in one or more database technologies (e.g. SQL, non-relational).
* Proven experience in using programming languages like C#, Angular, JSP, Java, PHP and frameworks like Spring Boot, and Symfony.
* A good understanding of SOLID principles and how to apply them.
* Ability to analyse and solve technical problems.
* Ability to clearly articulate ideas to target audience.
* Ability to effectively collaborate with other team members within an Agile Delivery team, within the Craneware Group Agile working practices.
* Good understanding of the use of source control.
* Basic understanding of software architecture.

new_jobs.title: Software Architect
new_jobs.description:
Vill du arbeta med avancerad mjukvaruarkitektur i en tekniskt ledande organisation? Hos oss får du en nyckelroll i att utveckla framtidens serviceverktyg och mjukvaruplattformar i nära samarbete med både interna team och internationella partners. Vi söker nu en Software Architect som vill kombinera teknisk spets med helhetsperspektiv.

**Som Software Architect kommer du att arbeta med:**

* Ta fram kravbilder och design av mjukvaruarkitekturer på system-, nod- och modulnivå
* Driva tekniska vägval, komponentval och bidra till roadmap för plattformar
* Stötta utvecklingsteam genom vägledning, utbildning och tekniskt ledarskap
* Delta i test, verifiering och releaseplanering av mjukvarulösningar
* Utföra avancerad felsökning samt ha dialog med intressenter

Som Software Architect inom vår mjukvarugrupp med fokus på serviceverktyg har du en central roll i att utveckla, vidareutveckla och säkra kvaliteten på våra mjukvarulösningar och plattformar. Du arbetar genom hela utvecklingskedjan, från att skriva/analysera krav och omsätta dem till hållbara arkitekturlösningar, till att säkerställa implementation, verifiering och vidareutveckling.

Rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med utvecklare, designers och systemingenjörer, där du fungerar som en teknisk ledare och kunskapsbärare. Du bidrar till att skapa struktur och riktning i utvecklingsarbetet genom att definiera arkitekturprinciper, etablera standarder och driva kontinuerliga förbättringar.

Du har även en viktig roll i kontakten med andra delar av organisationen, såsom produktion, marknad, samt med övriga R&D. Genom denna samverkan säkerställer du att lösningarna möter både tekniska krav och verksamhetens behov.

Tjänsten passar dig som trivs med att arbeta både strategiskt och operativt, har en stark analytisk förmåga och vill ta ett stort ansvar i att forma framtidens mjukvarulösningar. Här får du möjlighet att påverka teknikval, driva innovation och bidra till att skapa effektiva och robusta system med höga krav på kvalitet, säkerhet och funktionalitet.

**Till tjänsten som Software Architect söker vi dig som har/är:**

* Civilingenjörsutbildning inom mjukvara eller motsvarande
* Minst 5 års erfarenhet av fullstack med Windows-applikationer i C#, .NET och typescript/React
* God kunskap i engelska tal och skrift, meriterande om du även har goda svenskkunskaper

För att lyckas i rollen har du god kommunikativ förmåga, både skriftligt och verbalt och trivs med att samarbeta med andra för att nå gemensamma mål. Samtidigt arbetar du självständigt och har förmågan att driva aktiviteter framåt hela vägen till måluppfyllelse.

**Vilka är R&D Toyota Material Handling Europe?**
  
Toyota Material Handling Europe är världsledande inom materialhantering och vi gör stora investeringar för att möta framtidens behov. På vår R&D-avdelning i Mjölby arbetar 300 medarbetare med utveckling av våra produkter och tjänster samt nya innovativa lösningar. På Toyota arbetar vi med ett helhetsperspektiv där medarbetarna har ansvar från koncept till färdig produkt.
  
På Toyota förenar vi klassisk konstruktion med modern teknik inom automation, IoT och AI. Vårt produktutbud sträcker sig från manuella handtruckar till förarlösa fordon med avancerad teknik. På R&D avdelningen arbetar vi med korta utvecklingscykler för att möta efterfrågan på en snabbt växande marknad.

Medarbetarna inom R&D beskriver våra chefer och ledare som inkluderande, närvarande och prestigelösa. Vi på Toyota är måna om att skapa ett familjärt arbetsklimat med möjlighet till personlig utveckling och goda karriärmöjligheter.

**Din Framtid på Toyota Material Handling Europe**
  
På Toyota Material Handling Europe strävar vi efter att vara en vänskaplig, trygg och framåtsträvande arbetsplats. Vår kultur bygger på Toyotas värdegrund, där respekt och omsorg är centrala i det dagliga arbetet. Vi arbetar aktivt för att öka mångfalden och ta vara på olikheter, vilket stärker vår konkurrenskraft.
  
För att skapa förutsättningar till en hållbar vardag erbjuder vi våra medarbetare flextid och möjlighet till distansarbete på deltid.

Låter det intressant? Ansök i så fall senast 2026-10-25.

Du som söker jobb och har skyddad identitet ska kontakta HR, som kommer guida dig vidare för en säker ansökningsprocess.

**Kontakta gärna våra medarbetare för mer information:**

* Sandy Dahl, Rekryterande chef, sandy.dahl@toyota-industries.eu
* Josefin Nilsson, HR, josefin.nilsson@toyota-industries.eu
  

Instagram: ToyotaMHsweden

Linkedin: Toyota Material Handling Manufacturing Sweden AB

**We’re the first software business in the world to have our sustainability targets validated by the SBTi, and we’ve been recognized for the transparency and ambition of our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We’ve also recently been named as one of the world’s most innovative companies.**

**If you’re a curious and collaborative person who wants to make a big impact through technology, then we want to hear from you! Find out more at** **AVEVA Careers****.**

**For more information about our privacy policy and how to manage cookies, visit our** **Privacy Policy****.**

**Location: Sundsvall,** **Sweden (Hybrid, 50% working time at the office)**

**Employment Type: Full time**

**The job**

Join our Sundsvall team to design and develop innovative industrial software solutions. You'll work on challenging problems in data management and cloud-based systems that help our customers in industrial automation and engineering. All our cloud products are hosted in Kubernetes, and everything we build — whether cloud or on-premises — is designed for containerized applications.

We're looking for developers who are curious, collaborative, and eager to grow. Whether you're more experienced or earlier in your career, if you're passionate about solving complex problems and working with modern technologies, we'd love to hear from you. There's also the opportunity to work as a fullstack developer if that's where your interests lie.

**Key responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, and debug software applications in C#/.NET
* Collaborate with product owners, architects, and teams across our global organization
* Participate in code reviews and help maintain high quality standards
* Work in an agile environment with continuous integration and deployment
* Contribute to both new features and maintaining existing codebases
* Grow your technical skills and share knowledge with the team

**Essential requirements**

* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience)
* Extensive software development experience in C# and .NET
* Record of achievements using modern development practices including AI
* Ability to write clean, well-structured code
* Good communication skills and enjoy working collaboratively

**Desired skills and competencies**

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer / AI Engineer
new_jobs.description:
We're growing our engineering team and looking for both Software Engineers and AI Engineers to help build the next generation of Aleido's platform. Whether your strength is solid, scalable software or applying AI to real products, you'll join a team where AI isn't a side project. It's built into what we deliver and how we build it.

**About the role**

You'll work on Aleido's modular platform for product information, used by some of the world's leading industrial companies to create, manage and deliver technical content. You'll own work from specification to deployment, contribute to technical decisions and help shape how we engineer as a team.

**You'll join us in one of two directions:**

* As a Software Engineer, you'll focus on building high-quality features across the platform: APIs, cloud services and modular architecture on Azure and .NET.

* As an AI Engineer, you'll focus on bringing AI into the platform and our products: LLM-powered features, agent integrations, automation and tooling that turns AI capabilities into measurable customer value.

Both directions share the same foundation and work closely together.

**What you'll do**

* Own development tasks from specification to deployment.

* Write high-quality, scalable and maintainable code, using AI-assisted development to work faster without compromising quality.

* Contribute to design and architecture discussions and propose technical solutions.

* Perform thorough code reviews and contrubute to overall code validation and quality practices.

* Collaborate closely with Product Owners and UX to refine requirements.

* Support platform operations, monitoring and troubleshooting.

* Improve workflows, documentation and engineering standards, including how we work with AI.

* Stay curious about new technologies and help keep our solutions ahead of the curve.

**Who you are**

We believe that you have:

* A strong understanding of software engineering, cloud services and distributed systems.

* Good experience with Azure, .NET or an equivalent modern tech stack.

* An understanding of CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and observability.

* A clear grasp of API design, modular architecture and platform patterns.

* Hands-on experience using AI tools in your development work, and genuine interest in where this technology is heading.

* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, and a sense of ownership for what you deliver.

* Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

* Fluency in English, written and spoken.

For the AI Engineer direction, we also expect experience building with LLMs, AI services or frameworks (e.g. Anthropic, OpenAI or Azure AI services), and with integrating AI capabilities into .NET applications.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Azure cloud platform.

* Familiarity of AI/ML-enabled systems, including information flow, uncertainty and error propagation, common failure modes, and approaches to troubleshooting and debugging.

* Experience with agentic workflows, MCP or other AI integration patterns.

* Understanding of business process mapping and optimization techniques.

* Familiarity with content management, technical documentation or aftermarket information.

**Who we are**

Aleido is a Swedish international company with a long heritage of driving the development of product information and learning solutions. Our customers develop complex products or systems, or seek knowledge and confidence to create lasting change, within a wide range of industries including automotive, telecom, advanced machinery, rail and medtech. We are almost a thousand colleagues in five countries. Together we bridge the gap between technology and the people who depend on it – by making the advanced simply understood.

You'll be part of a tight-knit and innovative team where your work truly makes a difference. We believe in empowering people, embracing creativity and constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible with software and AI.

new_jobs.title: Sitecore Developer (.NET)
new_jobs.description:
Twoday is the leading digital transformation partner in Northern Europe with a global presence. With approximately 3,000 specialists, we collaborate with some of the most admired private and public organisations to deliver cutting-edge digital solutions. Our expertise spans software engineering, Data & AI, cloud platforms, digital experiences and business applications.

We are now looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to help transform a large-scale development and deployment platform from traditional DevOps into a modern AI-assisted and agentic engineering setup.

**Permanent position at Twoday | Copenhagen**

**Sitecore Developer (.NET)**

Are you an experienced Sitecore developer who enjoys being close to the code and turning business needs into reliable digital solutions? Twoday is looking for a hands-on developer for a business-critical assignment with a large Danish public-sector organisation.

You will be permanently employed by Twoday, with your first assignment carried out full-time on-site at the client’s offices in Copenhagen.

**The role**

You will join a development team responsible for maintaining, improving and further developing the client’s Sitecore-based solutions. Your focus will be practical software delivery: writing code, troubleshooting, implementing integrations and ensuring that solutions perform reliably in production.

You may contribute to technical decisions and solution design, but this is primarily a hands-on development role rather than a pure architecture position.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Developing and maintaining solutions in Sitecore and C#/.NET
* Implementing new functionality and improving existing solutions
* Building and maintaining integrations and APIs
* Troubleshooting defects and resolving technical issues
* Contributing to testing, code quality, documentation and deployment
* Collaborating closely with developers, testers and business stakeholders

**Your background**

We expect you to have:

* Solid professional experience with Sitecore development
* Strong hands-on skills in C# and .NET
* Experience with integrations, APIs and web-based solutions
* The ability to understand and work confidently in an existing solution landscape
* A structured approach to quality, maintainability and documentation
* The confidence to take responsibility for tasks from clarification through to implementation
* An open and pragmatic approach to using AI-assisted development tools where relevant

Experience with Sitecore upgrades, deployment, performance optimisation or complex public-sector solutions would be an advantage.

**Fluency in spoken and written Danish is essential, as daily collaboration and documentation take place in Danish. You must also be able and willing to work full-time on-site in Copenhagen.**

**What we offer**

At Twoday, you will become part of a strong professional environment where knowledge sharing, collaboration and technical quality are central. You will work on meaningful digital solutions while developing your skills alongside experienced colleagues.

The position is a permanent role at Twoday, working full-time onsite with one of our public-sector customers in Copenhagen.

Interested? We look forward to receiving your application.

new_jobs.title: Engineering Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About Us**

**nShift** is the leading global provider of cloud delivery management solutions (SaaS), we enable the frictionless shipment and return of almost one billion shipments across 190 countries each year. We are headquartered in London and Oslo and have over 460 employees across offices in Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark, the United Kingdom, Poland, the Netherlands, Belgium, and Romania.

Our software is used by many of the world leading e-commerce, retail, manufacturing, and 3PL shippers due to us having over 1000 carriers integrated into our platform, nearly 3 times more than our competitors!

If you buy goods online, there is a strong chance that nShift has powered that delivery, so come and join us as we shape the future of shipping, one frictionless journey at a time.

**About you**

You're an engineering leader who still enjoys being close to the code. You care about your people as much as about the product, and you're comfortable balancing delivery, quality, and team growth.

You are someone who:

* Builds and leads a high-performing team of developers and testers, with clear expectations and regular feedback
* Knows the status of every commitment the team has made, and acts early when something slips
* Holds a high bar for the team's work and your own, raised through clear expectations and direct feedback
* Communicates openly and clearly with the team, stakeholders, and management, including when the message is difficult
* Acts in the best interest of the company and the team when making tough decisions

**Purpose of role**

At nShift, the Engineering Manager's primary task is to lead, hold accountable, and deliver through a group of talented developers and testers, ensuring they thrive in a collaborative, high-performing environment.
  
You are part of the product trio together with the Product Manager and the Designer, aligning business goals, customer needs, and technical solutions. You are the team's voice to the wider organization and bring company priorities back to the team clearly and honestly.

**Your role includes:**

* Collaborating with the product trio to balance feature delivery with quality
* Supporting team development and maintaining a high-performing culture
* Communicating company goals and representing the team within the organization
* Owning delivery predictability and the team's say/do ratio, alongside technical excellence

**What you'll be doing**

**Technology**

* Ensure that daily work aligns with the tech vision, guiding principles, and minimum quality standards, including monitoring code quality through tools like SonarQube.
* Take part in design and architecture discussions, and review code regularly enough to have an informed view of quality and risk.
* Challenge estimates and technical approaches, drawing on your own engineering experience.
* Make sure that the technology managed by the team is resilient, secure, and up to date.
* Promote internal education, collaboration, and knowledge-sharing across platforms and teams.

**Process**

* Challenge your team to enhance their working methods, proactively addressing opportunities and obstacles with a critical mindset.
* Ensure that your team follows established processes, such as Kanban, Scrum and test management, in service of predictable delivery, and advocate for adopting best practices and tools.
* Own the team's delivery commitments. Track planned versus delivered work each sprint and quarter, report honestly on the gap, and drive corrective action.
* Identify blockers, dependencies and risks early, and resolve or escalate them before they affect delivery.

**People Management**

* Administer and oversee personal development plans, salary structures, and recruitment processes.
* Create opportunities for team members to stay motivated through mentorship, coaching, or delegating tasks to encourage professional growth.
* Set clear expectations for each engineer and manage performance against them, setting an example for your team to follow.
* Build and maintain a robust team with overlapping skills and knowledge, avoiding critical dependencies on single individuals.

**What you will bring**

This is a **hands-on management role**: you will know what your team is building, why it is late when it is late, and what you are doing about it. For our Data Exchange team, we are seeking candidates who embody the following characteristics:

**Technical Proficiency: A strong hands-on background in C# is required, with a proven history of technical expertise in software development**. Experience with front-end development frameworks is a plus, but not mandatory.

**Delivery Ownership:** A track record of teams that ship what they commit to, and comfort using metrics such as cycle time, sprint predictability, and say/do ratio to run the team.

**Professional:** You understand that it’s a part of a manager’s role to look out for the interest of the company, and you are prepared to manage difficult tasks with this in mind.

**Exacting Standards:** Maintaining high standards is vital as you consistently aim for excellence in both personal performance and the work produced by your team.

**Effective Communication:** Proficiency in both written and spoken English is essential for ensuring seamless communication within the team and with stakeholders.

**Requirements**

**The technologies this team uses are:**

* C#, .NET, .NET Core, React native, Vue.js
* PostgreSQL
* Docker, Bitbucket
* AWS, IaC
* SonarQube, JFrog

**Education and experience**

* BS degree in Computer Science or related field
* Minimum of 5 years as a hands-on engineer, plus 2-3 years of management experience

**Language Skills**

* Fluency in English is mandatory (written and spoken)

At nShift, we believe in embracing diversity in all forms and fostering an inclusive environment for everyone, which we believe is essential for our continued success. We're an equal opportunity employer, meaning all applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity, or disability status.

new_jobs.title: DevSecOps Engineer im Bereich PKI & HSM (m/w/d)
new_jobs.description:
Möchtest du die Zukunft unserer zentralen PKI- & HSM-Infrastrukturen aktiv mitgestalten? In einer Zeit, in der kontinuierliche Authentifizierung, Integritätssicherung und Datensicherheit von entscheidender Bedeutung sind, hast du die Möglichkeit, die aktuellen Infrastrukturen, IT-Systeme (Plattformen und Applikationen) aktiv zu betreiben, zu warten und diesen Bereich massgeblich weiterzuentwickeln. Dafür suchen wir dich als engagierten und motivierten DevSecOps Engineer (m/w/d) im Bereich PKI & HSM. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf dem Betrieb und der Weiterentwicklung unserer IT-Systeme mit Fokus auf Hardware Security Modules (HSM), Public Key Infrastrukturen (PKI) und weiteren relevanten Applikationen.

Deine Aufgaben

* Betrieb, Wartung und Weiterentwicklung der Systeme im Bereich PKI & HSM. Dazu gehören unter anderem HSM, PKI-Systeme, Credential Management Systeme (Smartcards, Hardware-Tokens) sowie Systeme für das Secret Management.
* Implementierung und Optimierung der Lösungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Product Ownern.
* Sicherstellung der Verfügbarkeit, Skalierbarkeit und Sicherheit der IT-Systeme durch Monitoring, Troubleshooting und kontinuierliche Verbesserungen.
* Automatisierung und Modernisierung von zentralen Systemen sowie deren Prozessen.
* Unterstützung bei der Anbindung neuer IT-Systeme an die PKI & HSM Infrastrukturen sowie bei der Analyse von Fehlern und der Behebung von Problemen.
* Mitgestalten einer langfristig belastbaren PKI, welche den heutigen und den bereits absehbaren Anforderungen gerecht werden kann.
* Enge Zusammenarbeit im DevOps-Team und dem Fachbereich in einer agilen Methodik (SAFe), um die Anforderungen an die IT-Systeme optimal umzusetzen und die Systemlandschaft gemeinsam weiterzuentwickeln.

Dein Profil

* Du hast eine abgeschlossene höhere Ausbildung in Informatik (FH, ETH, Uni) oder eine gleichwertige Weiterbildung.
* Du bringst mehrjährige Berufserfahrung sowie fundierte Kenntnisse mit, insbesondere in den Bereichen PKI & HSM Engineering sowie Key und Certificate Management und/oder Secret und Credential Management, idealerweise in einem regulierten Umfeld.
* Ebenfalls verfügst du über fundierte Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Thales Network HSMs, Microsoft ADCS, .Net Entwicklung und Powershell.
* Du weist ein umfassendes Verständnis von PKI sowie der zugrundeliegenden Kryptografie aus und besitzt praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und dem Betrieb moderner Lösungen, die die Anforderungen von On-premise-, Cloud- und SaaS-Systemen erfüllen.
* Deine strukturierte Arbeitsweise, dein analytisches Denkvermögen und deine ausgeprägten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten zeichnen dich aus.
* Du besitzt sehr gute Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch.

Unser Angebot

* Fachlich- oder persönliche Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten und einen Aufgabenbereich, der dir die Chance gibt, eigenverantwortlich deine Themen weiterzubringen
* Möglichkeiten Teilzeit zu arbeiten, Unterstützung bei Weiterbildungen, mobiles und flexibles Arbeiten sowie unbezahltem Urlaub
* Attraktive Zusatzleistungen und Vorsorgeleistungen weit über dem gesetzlichen Minimum
* Ein attraktives Gesamtpaket u.a. mit interessanten Nebenleistungen und Mitarbeitervergünstigungen (Sport, Freizeit, Kinderbetreuung, Krankenkasse)
* Lebe mit uns #mehrkönnen und #ITmadeinChreis5 – deine Kolleg:innen und Stakeholder sitzen alle im selben Haus, im Home Office oder im Haus über die Strasse – ohne Zeitunterschied

Für diese Stelle berücksichtigen wir ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen.
